obligations.ask: Attend the appointment about your case file

results.segment: You have an appointment about your case file at Grantley Legal Aid on 5 June 2026. Please arrive ten minutes early and bring this letter with you.
If you have any questions about this letter, our reception team will be glad to help.
We wrote to your landlord on 2 March and they have 28 days to reply to us, not to you.
